sql: SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.position = 1 AND results.time NOT LIKE '+%' ORDER BY races.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.time NOT LIKE '+%' AND results.fastestLap IS NOT NULL ORDER BY races.date ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.position = 1 ORDER BY races.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.driverId = (SELECT ds.driverId FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND ds.position = 1 ORDER BY r.date DESC LIMIT 1) AND results.fastestLap IS NOT NULL AND results.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY results.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.time NOT LIKE '+%' ORDER BY races.date LIMIT 1
SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.position = 1 AND results.time NOT LIKE '+%' ORDER BY races.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT fastestLap FROM results WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2009) AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM driverStandings WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2009 ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY position ASC LIMIT 1) AND fastestLap IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT results.fastestLap FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND results.position = 1 AND results.time NOT LIKE '+%' ORDER BY races.round ASC LIMIT 1
